title: RacketPal Rally Rally Count Leaderboard
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), running gait (`gait:metric`), hangboard sessions (`hangboard:session`), golf-swing metrics (`golfswing:metric`), power-meter intervals (`powermeter:interval`), basketball shot arcs (`shotarc:make`).
app: Sports and skill sensors — velocity-based-training bar trackers, running-form IMUs, climbing hangboard load cells, golf launch monitors, cycling power meters, and computer-vision shot trackers — logged to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=racketpal:rally rally_count=*
| stats sum(rally_count) as total_value, avg(rally_count) as avg_value by sport
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks sport values by total and average rally count across RacketPal rally events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `rally_count` values for each RacketPal rally event and review total and average rally count by sport.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total rally count.
grandmaExplanation: It quickly which sport shows the biggest rally count numbers in your RacketPal rally data.
